title: 2026 F-gas registry, annual-reporting and charging governance QA controls

sources.title: Fluorinated greenhouse gases and ozone-depleting substances charging scheme
The Environment Agency (fluorinated greenhouse gases and ozone-depleting substances) charging scheme 2025

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency F-gas and ozone-depleting-substances charging scheme page was updated on 19 May 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the 2026 update date when applying charging and registry rules.

facts.source_fact: The scheme covers fluorinated greenhouse gas activities and ozone-depleting-substance activities.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer that one regime's charges or reporting duties automatically apply to the other.

facts.source_fact: All charges were updated on 1 April 2026 in line with CPI.
facts.expected_handling: Use the applicable charge vintage rather than an older published amount.

facts.source_fact: The scheme states charges increase on 1 April 2027 and annually thereafter by no more than the relevant CPI measure.
facts.expected_handling: Treat future charges as indexed governance rules, not fixed 2026 amounts.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency makes the charging scheme under section 41 of the Environment Act 1995 with required approvals.
facts.expected_handling: Retain statutory-scheme provenance in compliance records.

facts.source_fact: The charging scheme extends to England, Wales and Scotland.
facts.expected_handling: Attach geographic extent before applying scheme rules.

facts.source_fact: The scheme came into force on 1 April 2025 and remains in force until revoked.
facts.expected_handling: Carry commencement and revocation status with version checks.

facts.source_fact: The person making a relevant application is liable for the application charge.
facts.expected_handling: Bind application charges to the applicant and application event.

facts.source_fact: The person making a relevant declaration is liable for the declaration charge.
facts.expected_handling: Keep declaration-charge liability separate from registration subsistence charges.

facts.source_fact: Registered persons are liable for relevant subsistence charges under the scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Require registration status before assigning subsistence-charge obligations.

facts.source_fact: Application charges are due in full on the date the application is made.
facts.expected_handling: Use the application date as the payment trigger.

facts.source_fact: Declaration charges are due in full on the date the declaration is made.
facts.expected_handling: Use the declaration date as the payment trigger.

facts.source_fact: The Agency may waive or reduce a charge where it is significantly disproportionate having regard to actual costs and expenses.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assume abatement; record an Agency decision where one exists.

facts.source_fact: Part 2 uses the meanings in the fluorinated-greenhouse-gas Regulation referenced by the scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the governing-definition source when interpreting F-gas fields.

facts.source_fact: The GB FGas Service is the Great Britain register administered by the Environment Agency for the referenced regulatory functions.
facts.expected_handling: Use the GB FGas Service as the registry identity in Great Britain records.

facts.source_fact: The listed F-gas application charge for relevant GB FGas Service registration is £377.83 in the current scheme text.
facts.expected_handling: Store amount, currency and scheme vintage together.

facts.source_fact: An annual subsistence charge applies to registered GB FGas Service users who are required to submit an annual report under the referenced Regulation.
facts.expected_handling: Link annual-report obligation and registry status before applying the subsistence rule.

facts.source_fact: The listed annual F-gas subsistence charge is £1,275.00 in the current scheme text.
facts.expected_handling: Store amount, annual basis and applicable scheme version.

facts.source_fact: The GB Ozone Depleting Substances Service is the registration, reporting and licensing system administered by the Agency and receives specified annual reports.
facts.expected_handling: Keep ODS reporting-system identity distinct from the GB FGas Service.

facts.source_fact: The listed ODS annual subsistence charge is £1,112.74 for relevant registered/reporting or licence-holding persons.
facts.expected_handling: Apply only where ODS registration/reporting or licence conditions are met.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach regime, geography, registry and liable-person scope before downstream use.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing F-gas and ODS obligations.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach charge year, update date and CPI-indexing status.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents stale charge or reporting rules.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry statutory source, registry identity, amount/currency and reporting trigger in derived outputs.
Do not convert registry or charging governance into a parcel-level measured emission without a separate parcel-binding gate.
